g.text: this laptop plays and records at the same time — a pair for every sample:
the same sentence, recorded three times:
the system, and I talk over it
step one, today — on the first recording, three things to hear:
delayed to line up, scaled to fit
after each subtraction — by ear, and in dB: how much of the echo is gone
the other two recordings, and keys 4 to 0: later today, once the method is on the slides
